about: IMG-SCALE: photos allowed to be drawn bigger than their frame (a deliberate crop). Each entry: a regex for the photo's file name (without its hash), an optional regex for the URL path, an optional maxFrame (px: only frames this small or smaller), and why.

allow.why: The sign-in hero is cropped on purpose to the tail lights, with no plate in the crop (signin.tsx, Review 19 #1).
Me's avatar is a close crop of your car photo when the car's card is right under it (Review 20 #29; REDESIGN-2, Me).
